findings.title: A link to a large T12 orbit runs the whole representation build in the island's hydration task: a long task of 51 to 103 ms at full speed, where a pick of the same node has none
findings.location: site/src/components/tools/t12/model.ts:575 (admitLink validates with new T12Tool(configOf(state), { defer: true, need: 'staged' })); site/src/components/tools/T12RepresentationBuilder.svelte:583-604 (readLink, called in the hydration $effect) and :548-549 (load builds a second T12Tool with need 'staged'); site/src/components/tools/t12/model.ts:194-216 (representationOf 'staged': startRepresentation, addMatrices and addSignedMoves for every node at once in one call)
findings.claim: When a T12 state comes from a link (/tools/rep/?g=..&k=.., or a lesson instance's prefixed keys), the hydration task runs minusculeNodes, orbitSize, play, minusculeMatrices and signedMoves of every node together. The same work after a pick runs one engine call per task (build() then representationSteps). So the hydration task is a long task at full speed on every built orbit of about 240 positions or more.
findings.expected: SPEC 7.6 'Main-thread work': 'No engine call on the main thread may become a long task (50 ms) on that phone.' The builders' record decisions/P5-A2.md commits T12 to 'A pick builds the representation one engine call per task (decide, enumerate, sign, ...)' and 'above 300 positions the signed moves take one task per node'. A link reaches the same states (any pick's Copy link) and should keep the same split.
findings.observed: Chromium 141, 360x800, 1x (no slowdown), 4 CPUs, Node 22.22.0, load 0.98 to 3.49, 5 runs each. The hydration task (the long task during which the island's ssr attribute is removed) has medians: E7 node 6 (756 positions) 65 ms [56, 57, 65, 80, 86]; C8 node 7 (1024) 81 ms [67, 79, 81, 85, 103]; B8 node 7 (1024) 68 ms [64, 67, 68, 70, 79]; D8 node 3 (448) 59 ms [52, 57, 59, 64, 69]; E8 node 8 (240) 51 ms [0, 0, 51, 54, 60]. With 3 runs: E6 node 4 56 ms and D7 node 5 61 ms. The same nodes reached by picks have no long task in any of those runs (median 0; one 53 ms task in 25 pick runs). Controls by link on the same boards with small orbits (E7 node 7, D8 node 1, B8 node 1, A2 node 2) have no long task in 12 runs. At 4x (phone-like): E7 node 6 link hydration 294, 299 and 352 ms against 89 to 131 ms for the longest task after a pick; E8 node 8 197 to 345 ms against 0 to 69. A source-mapped CPU profile of the C8 node 7 link at 1x puts readLink, admitLink, the T12Tool constructor and representationOf inside the hydration task (121 to 142 ms with profiler overhead). Inside it, addMatrices calls minusculeMatrices (34.5 ms sampled) and addSignedMoves calls signedMoves for all 8 nodes (10.8 ms sampled). T12.spec.ts 'no long task when E6/E7 is picked' tests picks only, so the gate's tests do not see this path.

Add a link case to T12.spec.ts's long-task tests.

findings.title: T12 classifies the same board three times on every pick: the steps of a pick resolve the board in three tasks, which defeats resolveBoard's per-microtask reuse
findings.location: site/src/components/tools/T12RepresentationBuilder.svelte:534 (defaultNode(resolveBoard(spec)) in the first step of build); site/src/components/tools/t12/model.ts:200 (representationOf -> startRepresentation(resolveBoard(spec)) in a later step); site/src/components/tools/t12/model.ts:409 (the T12Tool constructor's resolveBoard in load, after the steps); site/src/lib/state.ts:259-271 (resolvedThisRun is cleared at the next microtask, the RT-FIX P3-RT-07-02 mechanism)
findings.claim: T12 spreads a pick over several tasks, as SPEC 7.6 requires, and resolves the board in three of them. resolveBoard reuses a board object only within one microtask run, so each task gets a new object, and resolveBoard and the engine's guards classify each new object (E-11 caches per object).
findings.expected: SPEC 5.6, last sentence: 'A tool decides whether a board is of finite type by calling classify once when the board is loaded.' Every other tool measured in the phase 4 round classifies a picked board once (T10's extra computations are sub-boards inside the engine).
findings.observed: A DevTools logpoint on classifyUncached (source-map build): pick E6 3 computations (n=6: 3), E7 3, D4 3, B8 3, G2 3, and C8 after a link load 3. Load of /tools/rep/ 1. Load of M8 1. The link load ?g=E7&k=6 makes 2 (the default A2 once, E7 once), the reading the phase 4 round accepted. One computation costs 0.09 to 0.37 ms in Node (redteam-RT-07-p5-rep.test.ts), so no long task results, which is why this is minor.
